comments.author: penguingreentea
comments.body_html: I know it might not be everyone’s cup of tea but an earlier mod I made, Full Helmet Protection, adds throat+neck hitboxes to helmets. For me at least, it feels like a fun and fair way to balance helmets while removing more unfair deaths to lower-geared bots

comments.author: swafromsteam
comments.body_html: So helmets cover the neck hitbox? For example you wear an Altyn, you’ll get class 5 protection on your neck? Sounds great if that’s the case.

comments.author: penguingreentea
comments.body_html:
Yep that mod updates all helmets’ armor zones, and it can be a real difficulty bump if you’re used to popping bots in the heads with 9x19mm. Also if you and your bots are both high-level, then most helmets won’t really do anything different except protect you against scavs using low-level calibers (just like live tarkov) since endgame rounds pen armor classes 1-5 pretty well

Mostly it’s a mod that serves as a way to make most helmets useful in SPT throughout earlygame-midgame since I got tired of bots literally never hitting the top of my head unless I’m proning
